basis.rule: Anchors are vanilla guard booths (Land_Guardhouse, Land_Mil_Guardhouse1/2) more than 300 m outside every base extent, one per 150 m. The checkpoint stands 20, 28, 36 or 44 m from the booth on the first of 8 compass bearings that passes the per-piece rules; its lane runs toward the nearest settlement. The real road direction is not available offline, so lane alignment with the road is unverified.

purpose: Sandbag and barrier checkpoints beside the vanilla guard booths that stand away from the military bases.
